title: Capricor’s Duchenne therapy has new life after FDA grants 3-month extension
snippet: The FDA has granted a three-month extension for Capricor Therapeutics’ Duchenne muscular dystrophy hopeful deramiocel in order to review additional data and consider a refined indication. The new target action date for the therapy is November 22.

title: REGENXBIO’s Hunter syndrome gene therapy hit by FDA hold, stymieing resubmission plans
snippet: The FDA has placed a clinical hold on RGX-121 after small nodules or cystic masses were detected in the spines of five patients enrolled in REGENXBIO’s registrational trial. The biotech no longer plans to resubmit the candidate—which was rejected in February—in the near term.

title: Roche bets up to $2.3B in Hanmi pact for next-gen weight loss drug
snippet: Roche, through its subsidiary Genentech, will gain access to the investigational asset HM17321, which is designed to not only elicit weight loss but also improve lean mass.

title: Kennedy questions vaccination guidelines following Trump’s order to break up MMR
snippet: The current classifications of vaccine recommendations could imply that not all shots require the consent of patients or their parents, according to Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
